result.summary:
The group spec is measured at base 744616e3 and written: 78,710 bytes, pure ASCII, LF line endings, in the gitignored .qa-s80/ folder. The worktree's git status is empty. No migration is needed: there is no kb_ingest_compare RPC, and that RPC is the stated follow-up S81-17b. One FOCUS surface was found, the D14 Redis health flush (one Upstash HINCRBY/EXPIRE pipeline per compare, no Lua). It sits behind its own sub-flag, ENABLE_LIVE_ROBOTS_HEALTH_FLUSH, and can be severed into D14b with no other change (section 12.7); the ruling is the orchestrator's (Q-D14-2).

Flags and the D05 exposure ruling: S81-17 adds a NEW leaf, app/services/kb_ingest.py, with ENABLE_KB_INGEST plus a ruled sub-flag ENABLE_FIELD_STATUS_METADATA, which gates only metadata.field_status and is independent of the ingest flag.

Hooks (Q1): REST after the L3 moderation pass, before return result (scs :4774-4781); stream after the moderation pass, before the settle_complete yield (:5686-5692); the camera path goes through the same exit (image_routes :560). Each successful compare gets ONE _fire_and_forget(asyncio.to_thread(run_job)), labelled kb_ingest. The job writes through the S81-14 builders with insert-ignore only.

Identity confidence (Q2): it comes from the flag-free, pure result_gate.assess_result and is a pair value. The B1 flag is ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA and is not needed.

What the job writes: cards only at identity confidence high. Offers only for genuine, non-render methods on live registry hosts with an allow verdict, using one shared last_seen. Images under the D08 policy. Reviews from channel-1 JSON-LD only. NO kb_specs: the live LLM specs carry snippet indices, not source URLs, so no value can be cited. No kb_feedback. Gaps are written for identity high or medium.

kb_gaps increments (Q5): insert-ignore, then one select, then a compare-and-set update on demand_count with no retry. Lost increments are counted (gap_cas_lost) and the concurrency loss is a stated limit. State and source_hint never move on an existing row, and the G2 pdp_ namespace is never touched.

D14: a NEW leaf, app/services/live_robots.py, behind ENABLE_LIVE_ROBOTS_REGISTRY. Its verdict function re-homes the G2 url_gate (most restrictive of QarenBot and '*', expiry, challenge, origin).

Memo (Q3): a SECOND per-process memo of host,status,deny,robots,challenge. Widening merchant_registry.READ_COLUMNS would redden the frozen S15 R6 row (test_s81_s15_registry_robots.py:914-917) and couple D14 to ENABLE_MERCHANT_REGISTRY_DB.

Fetcher hooks: curl_fetch_html, curl_fetch_html_same_site (each hop), shopify _fetch_once (each hop; covers the .js/.json/UCP endpoints), woo, algolia (merchant origin), and URL mode. Base-path URL mode is hooked at its caller extract_from_url :1132 because fetch_page's source sha is pinned; _fetch_page_v2 is hooked on every hop and returns outcome robots_skip.

Counters: kept in their own ContextVar, never in the response's source_trace, and flushed in finally arms of the REST and stream try blocks. jsonld_widen.ROBOTS_ENTRY_LOOKUP gets a flag-first reader, so the D08 R13 row stays green. The UA is unchanged.

Q4: measured on the pinned upstash-redis 1.7.0, the sync Pipeline offers hincrby/expire/exec as one REST call. The service-role absolute health write was rejected: it means N row updates per compare and lost updates.

Q6: the corpus SHA at base with the group's four flags forced OFF is 601338261705718a85c8c4ff281cefd47368a8c7aa1b12c2aad501baae18a1ef (414 records / 1,656 calls). The hooks are not on the extract_price_from_html path.

Q7: E-rows are E1/E2 on tests/test_s81_kb_schema.py P01/P02 for kb_ingest.py only. The S15 p5/p6/R43 rows, the B4 fetch_page sha row and the shopify importer row are satisfied by construction: no robots_registry text in the new modules, no kb_merchants text in the fetchers.

Q8: no adapter receives the registry row; every lookup keys on the URL host.

The base pins passed and the comm set was derived (counts in the fields below).

Severable into D14b with no other change (spec 12.7; ruling asked as Q-D14-2). No other FOCUS surface: no migration, auth, quota, legal, consent, middleware, secret or client file.

Q-D14-2: keep the Redis health flush in G3 as telemetry counters (the cache_service.record_tier15_attempt class) or move it to D14b, keeping the group strictly SAFE?
Q-D14-3: gate the remaining adapters (Magento / Salla / OCC / rest_json) in a later D14c?

Q-S17-2: S81-17b (kb_ingest_compare RPC = migration 051, FOCUS) now or after the canary measures the job's thread time (up to about 23 PostgREST round trips per job)?
